title: AC Store — Acceptance Criterion YAML Schema
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for acceptance criterion files stored under docs/acceptance-criteria/. See ADR-007 for rationale and ID format specification.

id.description: Stable AC identifier. Supports multiple formats: base form PREFIX-NNN (e.g. ACS-100, FIN-001), hierarchical L1 form PREFIX-NNNx (e.g. ACS-100a), L2 form PREFIX-NNNx-N (e.g. ACS-500a-1), L3 extension form PREFIX-NNNx-N-y (e.g. ACS-500a-1-i), numeric-only hierarchy (e.g. BO-510-1), and compound-prefix forms (e.g. KM-DBF-001). Assigned at creation time; never changes.

title.description: One-line human-readable description of the criterion.

component.description: Component name matching a key in docs/components.json.

created_by.description: Path to the ticket (relative to repo root) that first introduced this criterion.

criteria.description: Multi-line Gherkin scenario body (Given/When/Then/And). When implements_pattern is set and the AC has no unique behavior beyond what the pattern provides, a plain-text placeholder is acceptable (e.g. 'No page-specific behavior — all behavior inherited from pattern.').

oneOf.description: AC ID of the replacement criterion (set when status is superseded_by). Must match the same hierarchical ID format as the id field.

amended_by.description: Ticket paths that subsequently amended this criterion.

covered_by.description: Test file paths (optionally with ::test_function) that verify this criterion.

implemented_by.description: Source file paths (optionally with #anchor) that implement this criterion.

origin_agent.description: Identity of the agent or workflow that created this AC file. Free-form provenance string — any non-empty value is valid. Historical agent names (e.g. business-analyst-v2, business-analyst-v3, create-ticket, refinement from now-deleted or renamed agents) remain valid and are never rewritten.

readiness.description: Lifecycle readiness state of this AC. draft = written but not reviewed (scanner ignores); reviewed = IT PO v3 has enriched and approved (scanner ignores); approved = user has signed off (scanner may pick up).

priority.description: Implementation priority of this AC. Set by the user (or PO v3) at approval time. Used by the scanner for ranking.

documentation_triggers.description: List of documentation types that must be produced for this feature. Valid on L1 ACs only. Set by product-owner-v3 based on the nature of the feature. Empty array means no docs needed (provide documentation_rationale in that case).

documentation_rationale.description: Required when documentation_triggers is empty on an L1 AC. Explains why no documentation is needed.

oneOf.description: Implementation lifecycle status for this AC. todo = not yet implemented; in_progress = implementation underway; done = implemented and verified.

Hierarchy level of this AC. L0 = top-level composite (portfolio/program); L1 = composite (epic/feature); L2 = implementable leaf (story/task); L3 = fine-grained implementable leaf (sub-task). L0/L1 ACs are composite — fulfillment is derived from children, not directly verified.

List of AC IDs that this AC depends on. Used for parent-child hierarchy links (child AC lists its structural parent) and for pattern composition (composite pattern lists its atomic component pattern IDs). Must not form a cycle — the check_ac_circular_deps pre-commit hook enforces a directed-acyclic-graph (DAG) invariant on all depends_on edges.

ID of the reusable behavior pattern this AC inherits from (e.g. 'PTN-001'). When set, the effective behavior is derived from the referenced pattern combined with any pattern_bindings. The criteria field may contain a plain-text placeholder rather than a full Given/When/Then scenario.
Key-value bindings that instantiate the referenced pattern for this AC. Values may be strings, arrays, or objects. Only meaningful when implements_pattern is set.

List of {word} placeholder strings that this pattern AC exposes as bindable slots. Only meaningful on pattern ACs (ACs that other ACs reference via implements_pattern). Each entry is a placeholder in the form '{slot_name}' matching a named placeholder in the criteria field. Consuming ACs must supply a value for every slot via pattern_bindings.
